subtitle: Family roots, stories and connections
emptyTitle: Every story begins with a root

fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen mode is not supported by this browser.

treeGestureHint: Drag to explore · Wheel to zoom

parentRelationshipHint: To link a parent to a child, select the parent in their profile and add “Parent of”.
